data.title: 小木曾雪菜 · 歌词本上的记号
data.description: 排练室里，雪菜用铅笔在歌词旁做了个记号，又低声把那一句唱了一遍。

data.promptProse: Curled up on a folding chair in an empty school music club room, Setsuna uses a wooden pencil to underline poignant lyric lines in an open notebook, softly mouthing the words to herself. Golden late-afternoon sunlight pours through dusty classroom windows, illuminating chalk dust, acoustic guitar cases, and the gentle focus in her brown eyes.
data.animaCaption: Curled on a folding chair in the empty music club room, she underlines a lyric in her open notebook with a pencil while softly mouthing the line. Golden afternoon window light illuminates floating chalk dust and her quiet focus.
